steps.action: Remove all PPE before exiting the patient room except a respirator, if worn.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove personal protective equipment (PPE) and a respirator, if worn.

steps.action: Gloves: using a gloved hand, grasp the palm area of the other gloved hand and peel off first glove.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove gloves.

steps.action: Slide fingers of ungloved hand under remaining glove at wrist and peel off second glove over first glove, then discard gloves in a waste container.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove and discard gloves.

steps.action: Goggles or face shield: remove goggles or face shield from the back by lifting head band or ear pieces.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove the goggles or face shield.

steps.action: If the item is reusable, place in designated receptacle for reprocessing; otherwise, discard in a waste container.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to place items in designated receptacles.

steps.action: Gown: unfasten gown ties, taking care that sleeves don't contact your body when reaching for ties.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to unfasten gown ties and ensure sleeves do not contact the body.

steps.action: Pull gown away from neck and shoulders, touching inside of gown only, turn gown inside out, and fold or roll into a bundle and discard in a waste container.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove and handle the gown.

steps.action: Remove the respirator after leaving the patient room and closing the door.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove the respirator and close the door.

steps.action: Mask or respirator: grasp bottom ties or elastics of the mask/respirator, then the ones at the top, and remove without touching the front, then discard in a waste container.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to remove the mask/respirator.

steps.action: If your hands get contaminated during removal of any item, immediately wash your hands or use an alcohol-based hand sanitizer.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to wash hands or use hand sanitizer.

steps.action: Wash hands or use an alcohol-based hand sanitizer immediately after removing all PPE.
steps.executor_reason: Physical action required to wash hands or use an alcohol-based hand sanitizer.
